//go:build e2e && (svc_k8s_runner || smoke)

package tests

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	runnerv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/runner/v1"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

// Capture the immutable backend observation once, before removal. Never relist
// to replace a mismatched UID or backend after a removal has started.
func nativeVolume(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, client runnerv1.RunnerServiceClient, key string) *runnerv1.VolumeListItem {
	t.Helper()
	listed, err := client.ListVolumes(ctx, &runnerv1.ListVolumesRequest{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, listed.GetBackendId())
	var expected *runnerv1.VolumeListItem
	for _, item := range listed.GetVolumes() {
		if item.GetVolumeKey() != key {
			continue
		}
		require.Nil(t, expected, "ambiguous fixture volume key")
		require.NotEmpty(t, item.GetInstanceUid())
		require.Equal(t, listed.GetBackendId(), item.GetBackendId())
		require.Equal(t, key, item.GetIdentityLabels()["volume_key"])
		expected = proto.Clone(item).(*runnerv1.VolumeListItem)
	}
	require.NotNil(t, expected, "fixture volume absent from native inventory")
	return expected
}

func removeNativeVolume(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, client runnerv1.RunnerServiceClient, expected *runnerv1.VolumeListItem) {
	t.Helper()
	require.NoError(t, pollUntil(ctx, pollInterval, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		removed, err := client.RemoveVolumeBound(ctx, &runnerv1.RemoveVolumeBoundRequest{Expected: expected})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("checked fixture volume removal: %v", err)
		}
		require.Equal(t, expected.GetBackendId(), removed.GetBackendId(), "removal confirmation must name the observed backend")
		switch removed.GetState() {
		case runnerv1.VolumeRemovalState_VOLUME_REMOVAL_STATE_ABSENT:
			return nil
		case runnerv1.VolumeRemovalState_VOLUME_REMOVAL_STATE_PENDING:
			return fmt.Errorf("fixture volume deletion pending")
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unconfirmed fixture volume removal: %s", removed.GetState())
			return nil
		}
	}))
}

func registerNativeFixtureCleanup(t *testing.T, client runnerv1.RunnerServiceClient, req *runnerv1.StartWorkloadRequest, workloadID string) {
	t.Helper()
	var expectedVolumes []*runnerv1.VolumeListItem
	// Register both callbacks before discovery can fail. LIFO removes the pod
	// first, then only volumes for which an immutable observation was captured.
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), cleanupTimeout)
		defer cancel()
		for _, expected := range expectedVolumes {
			removeNativeVolume(t, ctx, client, expected)
		}
	})
	registerWorkloadCleanup(t, client, workloadID)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), cleanupTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	for _, volume := range req.GetVolumes() {
		if volume.GetKind() != runnerv1.VolumeKind_VOLUME_KIND_NAMED {
			continue
		}
		expectedVolumes = append(expectedVolumes, nativeVolume(t, ctx, client, volume.GetLabels()["volume_key"]))
	}
}
